text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 23 Disember 2022 hingga 27 Disember 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri bertulang import

2. Kepak ayam

3. Lada benggala hijau

4. Lobak Merah

5. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

6. Babi hidup

7. Daging babi (perut)

8. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 13 Disember 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 23 December 2022 to 27 December 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Chicken wing

3. Green capsicum

4. Carrot

5. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

6. Live pig

7. Pork (belly)

8. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 13 December 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
